answer_1.quote: Text-to-SQL has drawn a great deal of attention from the semantic parsing community. The ability to query a database with natural language (NL) engages the majority of users, who are not familiar with SQL language, in visiting large databases. A number of neural approaches have been proposed to translate questions into executable SQL queries.
